title: MONEYLOG 2.5.1
notes: Fixed one-tap updates so the open app refreshes to the new version without requiring a close and reopen
Hardened the direct app-cache refresh fallback so refreshed files are served on the next reload
Fixed the Home mobile spacing caused by the wrapped top action row
Made the browser version open as a read-only Home preview before setup
Entering a real action from the browser preview now takes you directly to secure account setup
Polished transitions and interaction timing across the main UI
